title: Chicken Adobo
description: Filipino chicken braised in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, bay leaves and black pepper until tender, then reduced to a glossy sauce.
equipment: Large deep skillet or braiser with a lid

image.alt: Braised chicken adobo in a dark glossy sauce with bay leaves, beside rice

steps.text: Pat the chicken dry. Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat and brown the thighs skin side down until golden, {time 6-8 min}. Turn them over and pour off all but a spoonful of fat.
Add the garlic and stir for {time 1 min}. Pour in the vinegar and let it bubble for {time 2 min} without stirring, which softens its sharpness.
Add the soy sauce, water, sugar, bay leaves and peppercorns. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook gently, turning the chicken once, until very tender, {time 25-30 min}.
Uncover, turn the heat to medium-high and simmer until the sauce reduces and turns glossy, {time 5-8 min}. For crispier skin, broil the thighs skin side up for a few minutes while the sauce reduces.
Remove the bay leaves, spoon the sauce over the chicken and scatter with green onions. Serve with plenty of rice.

notes: Adobo tastes even better the next day; it keeps 4 days in the fridge.
Cane vinegar is traditional; white or apple cider vinegar work well.
